title: KuzconiaSMP ModPack
description: Was required for play on the KuzconiaSMP. A ModPack with light mods for gameplay and visual enhancements, keeping the vanilla charm.
body:
This was the ModPack required to play on the KuzconiaSMP (now shut down). 
But feel free to add and play it on your own worlds! :3 
_[If you were part of the SMP, u can use this to play on the local world that was shared!]_

This ModPack includes mods that keep the Vanilla feel while adding a refreshing touch to it.
- UI (Menus) and quality of life (Easy chest sorting) have been added + more!
- Shaders (Choose low or high end), mc optimization, & sound enhancements.  
- a huge variety of interactable furniture to use when designing your home interiors!
- Many other items that would make this list too long!

Check out a bunch of features in any of the videos linked here or from other creators who played on the KSMP: [Llama on the KSMP](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMtEsfKBKk_GWDedLuX5QqL9JFIVXF2to&si=7y-dVaY5jXiUQ2t2)

**DO NOTE: If you want Ray Tracing, which is the higher end of the modpack intended for powerful PC's please check out the [RT] version of the ModPack: [HERE](https://modrinth.com/modpack/kuzconiasmp-modpack-rt)**

_**Thanks, and enjoy playing with it on your worlds! :D**_
